text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- The Portuguese economy will enter a phase of high growth as in the golden years of the 1980s, said Vitor Constancio, a former governor of the Bank of Portugal, at a conference on the euro in Lisbon.
- The government of Mozambique would welcome the privatisation of the Cahora Bassa dam in northern Mozambique, Deputy Energy Minister Castigo Langa said. Portugal has a majority stake in the dam.

- Willi Arens, president of the European Textile Union Committee, who was in Oporto taking part in a congress of his union, said employment in textiles will fall in Portugal due to increasing textiles activities in central Europe.
- The government will open public competitions for new concessions to distribute natural gas in some cities in central Portugal, such as Portalegre, Santarem and Viseu.
- Spanish chemical company Repsol Quimica is interested in the privatisation of Portuguese chemical company Quimigal, the newspaper has learned.
- Economy Minister Augusto Mateus said he would concentrate on boosting the efficiency of Portuguese companies during the remainder of his mandate.
